title: Ebi Furai Roll
description: Crispy panko-fried shrimp with cucumber and a restrained Kewpie filling.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

ingredients.name: Neutral cooking oil
ingredients.note: For shallow-frying; not all oil is absorbed

steps: Peel, devein and pat dry. Make shallow cuts along the underside to keep them straighter when frying.
Dip in beaten egg, coat generously with panko and shallow-fry until the crust is golden and shrimp are opaque throughout. Drain on a rack.
Spread seasoned sushi rice over nori. Set two or more fried shrimp lengthwise with cucumber batons and a thin stripe of Kewpie.
Roll snugly, slice into eight pieces and serve while the panko is still crisp.
notes: Keep the shrimp as whole as possible for attractive cross-sections.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
Cook shrimp thoroughly until the flesh is opaque throughout.
